sections.title: Comparisons
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due_on,changes,unresolved,status from review_queue order by due_on

sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select distinct * from attention_queue order by detail,code

sections.title: Decisions outstanding
sections.sql: select comparison,ordinal,location,report_text,before_text,after_text,priority,decision,owner from change_register where decision in ('open','hold') order by comparison,ordinal

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by code,rule

sections.title: Signoffs
sections.sql: select p.code,s.revision,p.revision current_revision,s.actor,s.evidence from signoffs s join comparisons p on p.id=s.comparison_id order by p.code,s.revision
